steps.content: The guests enter the restaurant one after another and sit down at the long dining tables.
Everyone lets Cabernet have the head seat in the middle. You sit down next to her right.

Exquisite creamy almond-colored soup dotted with dark blue parsley has already been set in the shallow white plates on the tables. The light fragrance wafts into the guests' nostrils, igniting everyone's appetites.
Many have started to sip the soup as soon as they sat down. After tasting it, the guests gush with admiration and praise.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: I can tell that this is broth from excellent meat! It blends perfectly with the cream.

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: Ah, how smooth and silky it tastes! Its fragrance is permeating my whole mouth!

steps.speaker: Guest C
steps.content: The milky white color looks so beckoning, too! What a wonderful choice for an appetizer!

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: If you savor it carefully, you can taste a hint of a special flavour. The chef must've used a very rare spice!

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Yes, Yes! I taste it too!

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: A spice that gives you an exquisite aftertaste, right?

steps.speaker: Guest D
steps.content: After... oh yes, absolutely! The aftertaste is marvelous!
The guests babble away, all the while sneaking glances at Cabernet.
Cabernet fills a spoonful of soup, takes a gentle sniff, then empties it back into the plate.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The texture of the soup is quite delicate. The fat is well emulsified, blending perfectly with the cream.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: The fragrance is rich, and the color is pure. You can feel the chef's mastery just by the look and smell of the soup.
Cabernet puts down her spoon and looks around at the guests staring back at her. Everyone is waiting for her final judgment...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Mmm, very good.
No one knows if she's referring to the soup or the guests' commentary.
But no matter. Upon hearing Cabernet utter the words "very good," everyone relaxes and continues to shove spoonfuls of soup into their mouths. The wild food commentary also continues.
The most audacious commenters will also bellow out "Right, Miss Cabernet?" every once in a while.
Everyone's praise goads Kelvin into sipping a big spoonful of soup herself.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: How strange...

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: Though I can't taste food this hot... this soup feels familiar...

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Familiar?
Kelvin drinks another few spoonfuls, then nods confidently.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: I'm sure I've eaten this before...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: If I'm not mistaken... you're referring to the ice cream you had just now?
Cabernet's words light up Kelvin's eyes.

steps.speaker: Kelvin
steps.content: That's right! It's the ice cream! You're amazing, Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Certain ingredients can indeed be used for both soup and dessert, yet the flavors of the two we just had remain quite distinct...

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Seems like the chef really mastered her skills.
Ah... what a great honor it is to be praised by Miss Cabernet!
A familiar voice rings out from behind you, making you jump.
You look behind. A woman you've never seen before is standing behind you in a chef's outfit. She beams at Cabernet.
And thank you everyone, for enjoying and approving of my humble soup.
Out of the corner of your eye, you notice that most of the guests haven't given their spoons a rest. As they guzzle down one spoonful of soup after another, only their eyes are fixed on the speaker.
However... even if Miss Cabernet approves of this soup... this guest here doesn't seem to like it?
Is this soup not to your liking? If so, may I have your suggestions?
You are Miss Cabernet's chosen companion, so your opinion is of great importance to me.
Her slender fingers dig forcefully into your shoulders, making it impossible for you to resist.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Oh right, I forgot to introduce myself. I'm the head chef of this banquet. You can call me McGrath.
You're at a bit of a loss for what to do. You pick up a spoonful of soup to try, but Cabernet reaches out and stops you.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: He ate a lot of grapes just now, so he feels a bit full. He's not trying to avoid the soup on purpose.
steps.female_content: She ate a lot of grapes just now, so she feels a bit full. She's not trying to avoid the soup on purpose.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: I told him that he would ruin his dinner like that.
steps.female_content: I told her that she would ruin her dinner like that.

steps.speaker: ${PlayerName}
steps.content: Sorry...
McGrath shrugs at your apology, not seeming to care.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: No matter. I think you'll have more appetite when the main course is served. I hope by then, you can give me the answer I want.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I hope the same goes for you too, Miss Cabernet.

steps.speaker: Cabernet
steps.content: Mmm. I'm sure you'll surprise me.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Of course, Miss Cabernet!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: I worked so hard precisely for this moment. All I desire is your nod and your precious and invaluable approval.
As McGrath says this, she walks over quickly to a place where everyone can see her.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: That's why the most exciting part of this party will be the dinner banquet. I prepared it specially for Miss Cabernet!
McGrath's words make the entire restaurant buzz with excitement.

steps.speaker: Guest A
steps.content: Specially prepared for Miss Cabernet?! Then we're in for quite the treat, aren't we?!

steps.speaker: Guest B
steps.content: Ah... Wh-what a time to be alive!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Yes, it's indeed a great time... you're in for the ultimate feast!

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: As for the ingredients used for this dinner... to be honest, before today, I too had thought it was only to be found in legends.
McGrath stares at Cabernet intently as she says this, as if expecting some reaction from her face.
But indeed, Cabernet's smile fades somewhat at the mention of the word "ingredients."
The ultimate feast, legendary ingredients... these proclamations are really stirring the pot, and all the guests are eagerly chatting about them.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Not only that... everyone must be curious about the "Ocean Messenger" mentioned in the invitation...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Hehe, of course, since it's a feast to "please all tastes," how could we not invite the Thaumas Society's Ocean Messenger, who devotes herself to bringing happiness to humans?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: She's already at the banquet hall, waiting for everyone to arrive.
The sudden news makes you frown.
The "Ocean Messenger" is already here? You couldn't get any info about her at the pool party just now. How involved is she with this party? What is her goal?

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: But...
McGrath draws out her voice, interrupting your train of thought. Everyone's eyes focus on her again.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: Though everyone here shares an equal opportunity to sit at the dinner table...

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: The legendary ingredients are extremely rare and limited in quantity.

steps.speaker: McGrath
steps.content: So... I will wait for everyone on Level B1. There are a limited number of seats for the dinner banquet, and the spots are first-come-first-served.
McGrath ends her speech with a dramatic wave of her hand. Right on cue, the elevator doors next to her open with a ding.
